newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView keeps IBM buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView keeps IBM buy.

text.p: SoundView Financial analyst Gary Helmig reiterated a buy rating on International Business Machines Corp, saying that the past decline in its shares amid a recent downturn of technology stocks was unwarranted.

-- Helmig said that reasons for recent earnings warnings by Intel Corp and Seagate Technology Inc do not apply to IBM. IBM is one of Intel's biggest customers and it is not seeing a shortage of Intel's popular MMX chip.
-- "IBM is growing faster than Compaq in PCs, they had a very strong April and May," Helmig said.
-- An upcoming mainframe announcement is also a positive.
